body:
`make_request_to_kobo_store` (cps/kobo.py:95-103) issues a bare
`requests.request(..., timeout=(2, 10))` on the request greenlet. This app serves gevent WITHOUT
monkey.patch_all(), and requests/urllib3 socket reads do not yield, so each call parks the hub
for up to 2s connect + 10s read — freezing every other request.

Reached from `redirect_or_proxy_request` (cps/kobo.py:108-119) for every non-GET request; GETs
are cheap 307 redirects. Devices generate non-GETs during normal use — reading-state POSTs to
unimplemented endpoints, preview POSTs and library mutations all land in
`HandleUnimplementedRequest` (cps/kobo.py:1892-1899).

Gated on `config_kobo_proxy`, which defaults off — but it is ON on the maintainer's own
instance, and it produces exactly the "the whole server stalls while my Kobo syncs" symptom.

Measured from that instance's container, three calls to https://storeapi.kobo.com:

    connect=0.139s total=0.240s
    connect=0.021s total=0.125s
    connect=0.025s total=1.077s

So 0.1-1.1s of whole-app freeze per proxied call in normal conditions, and up to 12s if the
store is slow or unreachable.

Frequency on a real instance is UNKNOWN and could not be established: `HandleUnimplementedRequest`
logs at debug and the instance runs at INFO, so the absence of log lines proves nothing. Raising
the log level for one sync cycle would settle it.

Fix shape: offload via `parallel.run_blocking`, as `cps/search_metadata.py:315` already does for
the same class of call. Note that Flask contextvars do not cross that hop, so build the request
arguments on the greenlet and offload only the `requests.request(...)` call itself.
title: Kobo store proxying blocks the request greenlet for up to 12s per non-GET call
